Plans pay monthly with a 20% withhold; hospitals must meet targets on at least 8 measures to receive the withheld quality payment (no partial payment). Preprint lists the estimated federal share as $1,887,207,120 and non-federal share $471,801,780.

notes: Plan keys: aetna, humana, passport (Passport by Molina), united, wellcare. PA metrics are each plan's own CY2025 CMS-0057-F posting with slightly different definitions (UnitedHealthcare includes delegated vendors and reports 'not approved'; WellCare cautions its data may differ from regulatory filings; Passport posts rounded percentages without counts); appeal-overturn denominators differ by plan. The Aetna PDF was blocked to curl (Akamai) but retrieved through WebFetch. Enrollment series values are sums of MCO plan-type counts excluding fee-for-service (Dec 2024 includes Anthem). MCPAR premium revenue and fair-hearing counts duplicate DecisionPro's mcparPlanPeriod export and were re-read from the CMS PUF only to size estimates. Kentucky's contract PA clocks (5 days standard, 24 hours expedited) are tighter than the federal 7-day/72-hour rule effective Jan 1, 2026; Humana's and Aetna's postings cite the federal 14-day/72-hour pre-2026 limits. Estimates (claim denial, withhold dollars, credentialing ceiling, clean-claim placeholder) are low-confidence models and must be shown as estimates. MCPAR 2024 encounter-data timeliness (Aetna 97, Humana 86, Passport 88, United 74, WellCare 96, Anthem 93 %) is already in DecisionPro and is MCO-to-state reporting, not provider payment timeliness.
